title: Getting started with helvetia
text: Swiss municipal data one time reference, must mixed : STATPOP population 2021 counted 31 December 2021, BFS publishes whole series one municipality stand (“Raumbezug”, e.g. 6 April 2025). stand, year, decides register geometries fit. BFS number guarantee boundaries. geoGemeinde() returns recent geometry stand date reports message differs; ThemaKart stands mostly 1 January. Compare unique(geo$stand_d) stand, check mutations gemeindeMutationen(unique(geo$stand_d), stand). Arealstatistik reported stand gem_stand_d well:
code: library(helvetia)  pop   <- popGemeinde(year = 2021) stand <- unique(pop$gem_stand_d)        # spatial reference of the cube gem   <- gemeinde(date = stand)         # register of exactly that stand geo   <- geoGemeinde(date = stand)      # geometries valid on that date  # check the join before using it setdiff(unique(pop$gem_id), gem$gem_id) setdiff(unique(pop$gem_id), geo$gem_id)  popTotal <- aggregate(ch_n ~ gem_id, data = pop, FUN = sum) br <- cut(log10(popTotal$ch_n), 6) plotMap(geo, id = popTotal$gem_id,         col = hcl.colors(6, "Blues 3", rev = TRUE)[br], border = NA) area <- arealGemeinde(period = "2013/18", nClasses = 17) unique(area$gem_stand_d) table(attr(area, "sumCheck")$check_c)   # completeness of the class sums

title: Get the Land Use Statistics by Municipality — arealGemeinde
text: data come dataflow CH1.AREA/DF_AREA_NOAS BFS SDMX dissemination service (stats.swiss). Three time concepts kept apart: period_x survey period (e.g. "2013/18"), publication boundary year; gem_stand_d municipality boundary stand results reported ; year aerial photographs value based kept flight_year_x source delivers . Missing, zero suppressed values distinguished value_status_c: "observed" (including true zeros), "suppressed" (confidentiality), "-applicable" (value exist) "missing" (delivered, including cells absent response). raw SDMX observation status kept obs_status_c. checkSums = TRUE sum classes requested level compared, per municipality, sum four main domains; differences threshold hectares raise warning. sum checkable values present: municipalities missing suppressed class domain reported checkable instead compared incomplete sums. outcome per municipality kept attribute "sumCheck" (columns gem_id, check_c "ok", "difference", "-checkable", diff_ha). Results cached per period, level region codelist (.e. municipality stand) source, new municipality stand dataflow never served older cached copy.

title: Get the Mutations of Municipalities — gemeindeMutationen
text: history comes AGVCH mutation service kept separate municipality stock returned gemeinde(). row links one predecessor version (old_*) one successor version (new_*) mutation; merger three municipalities therefore yields three rows sharing mutation_id. Several predecessors successors never collapsed one field. service delivers type code, mutation_type_c derived structure mutation: "creation", "abolition" predecessor successor. "merger" several predecessors, one successor. "split" one predecessor, several successors. "territory-exchange" several municipalities persist. "reorganisation" many--many mutation. "rename", "renumber", "reassign" one--one change name, BFS number district; combinations joined hyphen order, e.g. "rename-reassign". "" one--one without detectable change, e.g. pure territory change territoryExchange = TRUE. "reassign" refers district version: district renamed gives municipalities new district version.

what: helvetia: Swiss Public Statistics, Regional Classifications and Spatial Data — helvetia-package
title: helvetia: Swiss Public Statistics, Regional Classifications and Spatial Data — helvetia-package
text: helvetia gives small, stable API official Swiss sources maps one historicisable data model. functions fall six groups: Registers – units exist given date: Statistics – values per municipality: Geometries – polygons points: Maps (formerly bfsMaps): plotMap(), addGewaesser(), stampBfs(). Spatial tools: combineRegions(), neighbours(), locate(), geocode(). Sources: sourceInfo(), cacheList(), cacheClear(). Column names encode type suffix: _id identifiers, _x text, _c codes, _n numbers, _d dates, _l logicals. Register stands (stand_d), statistical years (jahr_n), survey periods (period_x) boundary stands (gem_stand_d) never mixed: bare gem_id sufficient historical analyses. column names follow attribute conventions source databases therefore snake_case, unlike function arguments list components, lowerCamelCase.
